summary: Iteration 370 - Three Bug Fixes VERIFIED. All tests pass. (1) QR Modal via React Portal renders centered in viewport (y=292, center_x=960). (2) LicenseBanner shows NO false-positive - status=disabled in preview env means no banner. (3) Capabilities/Module fixes: 67 caps across 13 categories including new tasks/resources/invoices/fleet; MODULE_MAP includes meetings/surveys; ghost caps removed from ROLE_DEFAULTS.

qr_modal_portal_fix.description: QR Modal renders via createPortal to document.body. Modal position: y=292 (within viewport 0-1080), center_x=960 (horizontally centered). Contains QR image, deep-link, PNG download button, and Schliessen button.

license_banner_false_positive_fix.description: GET /api/license/status returns status='disabled' in preview env (no LICENSE_SERVER_URL). LicenseBanner component correctly shows NO banner when status is 'disabled'. No 'Anwendung ist gesperrt' text found on page.

capabilities_67_across_13_categories.description: GET /api/admin/capabilities returns 67 capabilities across 13 categories: module, news, meetings, chat, documents, scheduling, surveys, tasks, resources, invoices, fleet, admin, global.

new_category_labels.description: New categories have correct German labels: Aufgaben (5 caps), Ressourcen & Catering (9 caps), Rechnungen & Buchhaltung (4 caps), Fuhrpark (1 cap).

ghost_caps_removed.description: Ghost caps (resources.book_with_approval, resources.cancel_any, resources.process_catering) are NOT in ROLE_DEFAULTS for any role.

module_map_meetings_surveys.description: GET /api/user/permissions for admin includes 'meetings' and 'surveys' in permissions array. MODULE_MAP correctly maps meetings→view:meetings, surveys→view:surveys.

sichtbare_module_list.description: Group dialog shows all 13 modules in SICHTBARE MODULE list: Dashboard, News & Mitteilungen, Umfragen, Aufgaben, Ressourcen, Webkonferenz, Terminplanung, Chat, Kalender, Aufnahmen, Profil, Verwaltung, Auswertungen.

capability_selector_categories.description: CapabilitySelector shows all 13 category sections with correct counts: module(12), news(8), meetings(6), chat(3), documents(4), scheduling(2), surveys(4), tasks(5), resources(9), admin(7), fleet(1), invoices(4), global(2).

critical_code_review_comments: QR Modal fix uses createPortal(modal, document.body) to bypass ancestor transform breaking position:fixed - correct approach
LicenseBanner fix: on fetch error, setStatus(null) instead of showing error banner - prevents false-positives during network issues
CATEGORY_LABELS in CapabilitySelector.js correctly includes all 13 categories with German labels
ALL_MODULES in GroupsPanel.js correctly includes all 13 modules including surveys, tasks, resources, meetings
MODULE_MAP in permissions.py correctly maps meetings and surveys to their view:* capabilities
Ghost caps removed from ROLE_DEFAULTS - resources.book_with_approval, resources.cancel_any, resources.process_catering were never used in codebase
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 370 fixes three bugs: (1) QR Modal now uses React Portal to document.body for correct viewport positioning, (2) LicenseBanner no longer shows false-positive 'Anwendung ist gesperrt' on network errors - only when server confirms invalid status, (3) Capabilities/Module alignment: 67 caps across 13 categories, MODULE_MAP includes meetings/surveys, ghost caps removed. All tests pass.
